_comment: Posts are TEMPLATES, not finished sentences. Anything in {braces} is filled in when the
post is written, so one line here becomes hundreds of different posts in play. That is
the only honest way to promise you will rarely read the same thing twice -- a fixed list
{here}     the zone the player is actually standing in
{yours}    the gang the player runs with
{subject}  whatever the event passed in -- a gang, a product, a job
...plus every list under "slots" below, by its key.
POST SETS under "posts": Ambient is the everyday chatter, and the rest are keyed to
things that happen. Add lines to any of them and they are picked up on next launch.
An unknown slot prints its own braces, so a typo is visible rather than silent.
Authors are just people. The avatar colour is derived from the handle, so somebody always
looks the same without a colour being stored for them. "gender" decides which of the
game's phone-contact pictures they get on a notification -- male, female, or none for
an organisation, which draws from the neutral icons.
